FINAL PRODUCTION CLOSEOUT — COMPLETE THE LAST PARTIAL AND DEPLOY 100%

OWNER DIRECTIVE

The latest report shows:

- 6 modules PASS
- 1 module PARTIAL
- 0 modules FAIL

Do not restart the entire project.
Do not create another app.
Do not return another broad narrative.

Finish the remaining Mobile QA, correct misleading autonomous statuses, deploy any required fixes, and issue the final production acceptance report.

==================================================
ITEM 1 — FREEZE THE CURRENT PRODUCTION BASELINE
==================================================

Record before changing anything:

- repository
- branch
- GitHub HEAD SHA
- CI SHA
- Render API SHA
- Render worker SHA
- /version SHA
- boot time
- APK version
- APK versionCode
- APK SHA-256
- rollback SHA

Required parity:

GitHub HEAD
=
CI SHA
=
Render API SHA
=
Render worker SHA
=
/version SHA

If parity does not match, deploy the exact green GitHub SHA first.

ITEM 1:
PASS / FAIL

Do not continue until PASS.

==================================================
ITEM 2 — PROVIDE A PERMANENT APK DOWNLOAD
==================================================

Do not use tmpfiles.org as the final production distribution location.

Upload the signed APK to an IVX-controlled location:

- ivxholding.com/apk/
- IVX-controlled S3/CloudFront
- EAS build artifact
- GitHub Release under the owner repository

Required:

- permanent URL
- HTTPS
- correct MIME type
- HTTP 200
- file size
- SHA-256
- version
- versionCode
- package/application ID
- signing certificate fingerprint
- expiration: none unless explicitly documented

The current temporary link may expire and cannot be final production proof.

ITEM 2:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 3 — REAL ANDROID DEVICE INSTALLATION
==================================================

Install the production APK on a physical Android phone.

Record:

- manufacturer
- device model
- Android version
- APK version
- versionCode
- package name
- installation timestamp
- fresh-install result
- update-over-old-version result
- uninstall/reinstall result
- device restart result

Required evidence:

- installation screenshot
- app icon screenshot
- app version screenshot
- timestamp
- installation log or package-manager result

ITEM 3:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 4 — REAL DEVICE COLD-START QA
==================================================

Test from a fully closed application.

Measure:

- splash duration
- first screen visible
- session restoration
- first useful content
- owner dashboard ready
- Aura ready
- IVX IA composer ready

Verify:

- no white screen
- no blank screen
- no infinite spinner
- no startup crash
- no ANR
- timeout fallback works
- retry works
- offline message works
- reconnection works

Run:

1. Fresh install launch
2. Warm launch
3. Launch after device restart
4. Launch while offline
5. Launch after network restoration

ITEM 4:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 5 — OWNER SIGN-IN DEVICE QA
==================================================

Test on the installed Android APK:

1. Valid owner login
2. Invalid password
3. Unknown account
4. Logout
5. Login again
6. App restart with session persistence
7. Background/resume
8. Expired-session recovery
9. Non-owner login
10. Non-owner attempts owner route
11. Owner-only Aura visibility
12. Autonomous Dashboard visibility

Required:

- valid owner → 200 and owner workspace
- no token → 401
- authenticated non-owner → 403
- no credential or token exposure
- no account enumeration
- session restores correctly
- logout clears protected state

ITEM 5:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 6 — COMPLETE DEVICE JOURNEY
==================================================

On the real phone, complete this sequence:

HOME
→ SIGN UP
→ VERIFY
→ SIGN IN
→ MEMBER PROFILE
→ BUYER
→ INVESTOR
→ JV DEALS
→ TOKENIZED
→ IVX IA CHAT
→ AURA
→ AUTONOMOUS DASHBOARD
→ REELS
→ SETTINGS
→ LOGOUT
→ LOGIN AGAIN
→ SESSION RESTORE

For each screen verify:

- route opens
- real production data
- no dead buttons
- no clipped content
- no blank screen
- correct authorization
- correct back navigation
- loading terminates
- errors are recoverable

ITEM 6:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================

Create one controlled production member from the Android APK.

Verify:

- one Supabase auth user
- one canonical member
- correct registration source
- correct email normalization
- correct phone normalization
- correct role
- consent records
- audit event

- logout/login works
- retry does not duplicate

Return:

- masked email
- auth_user_id
- member_id
- role ID
- audit event ID
- trace ID
- final status

PASS / FAIL

==================================================

- Buyer
- Investor
- JV Deals
- Tokenized

Verify:

- canonical member reused
- role-specific profile created once
- duplicate submission prevented
- correct module visibility

==================================================

1. What is 7 multiplied by 8?
2. What is a REIT?
3. Is a REIT a type of investment?
4. What is DST?
5. Is DST used for 1031 exchanges?
6. What is 15 percent of 200?
7. Can IVX IA work 24/7?
8. Show current autonomous status.
9. Diagnose current production health.
10. Show the current production SHA.

Verify:

- correct semantic routing
- general questions do not receive unrelated IVX-specific fallback answers
- no `24/7` math-parser bug
- no duplicate messages
- stable ordering
- history survives restart
- keyboard does not cover composer
- retry works
- no fake progress
- owner chat uses the intended AI provider

ITEM 9:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================

==================================================

Test all Aura data sources from the installed APK:

- /api/ivx/owner-ai/status
- /api/ivx/autonomous/qa
- /api/ivx/autonomous/credentials
- /api/ivx/autonomous/runs/summary

Verify:

- real data
- HTTP 200
- loading state
- error state
- empty state
- retry
- pull-to-refresh
- background refresh
- no duplicate polling
- owner-only authorization
- no stale values after refresh

ITEM 10:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 11 — AUTONOMOUS ENGINE STATUS CORRECTION
==================================================

Current report shows buyer and JV runs as `failed` because they found zero new records.

This must be classified accurately.

Use terminal states such as:

- completed
- completed_no_results
- failed
- timed_out
- cancelled
- blocked
- owner_action_required

Rules:

- zero discoveries is not automatically a failure
- genuine HTTP or processing failure remains failed
- no false PASS
- no false FAIL
- dashboard summary must explain the status

Audit all 11 engines:

1. daily_deploy_monitor
2. daily_technology_ideas
3. daily_self_audit
4. daily_tokenized_buyer
5. daily_investor_engine
6. daily_buyer_engine
7. daily_enterprise_os
8. daily_capital_outreach
9. daily_jv_engine
10. daily_executive_report
11. daily_drift_detection

For each return:

- latest run ID
- current status
- records discovered
- evidence count
- error
- correct terminal classification

Rerun buyer and JV after the correction.

ITEM 11:
PASS / FAIL

==================================================
ITEM 12 — REELS AND MEDIA DEVICE QA
==================================================

Test on the real phone:

- open feed
- scroll for 15 minutes
- play at least 10 videos
- pause/resume
- background/resume
- rotate device if supported
- upload an image
- upload a video
- retry failed upload
- close and reopen app

Verify:

- no crash
- no ANR
- no duplicate cards
- no frozen video
- no infinite loading
- stable ordering
- media persists
- memory remains controlled

PASS / FAIL

- network loss during registration
- network loss during chat
- network loss during Aura refresh
- network loss during reels upload
- backend restart during an authenticated session
- app killed during request
- device restarted

Verify:

- no duplicate member
- no duplicate role
- no lost confirmed message
- no corrupted state
- clear error
- safe retry
- session recovery

- cold start
- warm start
- owner login
- first chat response
- member registration submission
- Aura first render
- autonomous dashboard load
- reels first playback

- battery impact after 15 minutes

Return:

- p95 where multiple samples exist

- logout clears protected data
